entries.title: Luke 15:1
segments: ¶And all the tax-gatherers and the sinners were coming near to him to hear him;

entries.title: Luke 15:2
segments: and the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This [man] receives sinners and eats with them.

entries.title: Luke 15:3
segments: And he spoke to them this parable, saying,

entries.title: Luke 15:4
segments: What man of you having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, does not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

entries.title: Luke 15:5
segments: and having found it, he lays it upon his own shoulders, rejoicing;

entries.title: Luke 15:6
segments: and being come to the house, calls together the friends and the neighbours, saying to them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep.

entries.title: Luke 15:7
segments: I say unto you, that thus there shall be joy in heaven for one repenting sinner, [more] than for ninety and nine righteous who have no need of repentance.

entries.title: Luke 15:8
segments: Or, what woman having ten drachmas, if she lose one drachma, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and seek carefully till she find it?

entries.title: Luke 15:9
segments: and having found it she calls together the friends and neighbours, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.

entries.title: Luke 15:10
segments: Thus, I say unto you, there is joy before the angels of God for one repenting sinner.

entries.title: Luke 15:11
segments: ¶And he said, A certain man had two sons;

entries.title: Luke 15:12
segments: and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give to me the share of the property that falls [to me]. And he divided to them what he was possessed of.

entries.title: Luke 15:13
segments: And after not many days the younger son gathering all together went away into a country a long way off, and there dissipated his property, living in debauchery.

entries.title: Luke 15:14
segments: But when he had spent all there arose a violent famine throughout that country, and he began to be in want.

entries.title: Luke 15:15
segments: And he went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

entries.title: Luke 15:16
segments: And he longed to fill his belly with the husks which the swine were eating; and no one gave to him.

entries.title: Luke 15:17
segments: And coming to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have abundance of bread, and *I* perish here by famine.

entries.title: Luke 15:18
segments: I will rise up and go to my father, and I will say to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and before thee;

entries.title: Luke 15:19
segments: I am no longer worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

entries.title: Luke 15:20
segments: And he rose up and went to his own father. But while he was yet a long way off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell upon his neck, and covered him with kisses.

entries.title: Luke 15:21
segments: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven and before thee; I am no longer worthy to be called thy son.

entries.title: Luke 15:22
segments: But the father said to his bondmen, Bring out the best robe and clothe him in [it], and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet;

entries.title: Luke 15:23
segments: and bring the fatted calf and kill it, and let us eat and make merry:

entries.title: Luke 15:24
segments: for this my son was dead and has come to life, was lost and has been found. And they began to make merry.

entries.title: Luke 15:25
segments: And his elder son was in the field; and as, coming [up], he drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing.

entries.title: Luke 15:26
segments: And having called one of the servants, he inquired what these things might be.

entries.title: Luke 15:27
segments: And he said to him, Thy brother is come, and thy father has killed the fatted calf because he has received him safe and well.

entries.title: Luke 15:28
segments: But he became angry and would not go in. And his father went out and besought him.

entries.title: Luke 15:29
segments: But he answering said to his father, Behold, so many years I serve thee, and never have I transgressed a commandment of thine; and to me hast thou never given a kid that I might make merry with my friends:

entries.title: Luke 15:30
segments: but when this thy son, who has devoured thy substance with harlots, is come, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

entries.title: Luke 15:31
segments: But he said to him, Child, *thou* art ever with me, and all that is mine is thine.

entries.title: Luke 15:32
segments: But it was right to make merry and rejoice, because this thy brother was dead and has come to life again, and was lost and has been found.
